description:
Port the upstream FooterDataProvider from footer-data-provider.ts. Supplies live data to the Footer component without coupling it to OTP plumbing.

**Git branch detection:**
- Watch `.git/HEAD` for changes (filesystem polling or :fs inotify)
- Parse `ref: refs/heads/{branch}` for branch name, detached HEAD shows short SHA
- Cache result, invalidate on file change
- Graceful fallback: nil when not in a git repo

**Extension status store:**
- Map of `{extension_id, status_text}` pairs
- Extensions register/update their status line via a public API
- Footer reads the current snapshot on each render

**Implementation:**
- New GenServer `OctoPi.TUI.FooterData`
- `start_link(cwd: path)` — starts git watcher for the given directory
- `get_git_branch(pid) :: String.t() | nil`
- `get_extension_statuses(pid) :: %{String.t() => String.t()}`
- `set_extension_status(pid, key, text)` / `clear_extension_status(pid, key)`
- Wire into Interactive.do_run: start FooterData, pass to Footer component

**Upstream ref:** `footer-data-provider.ts`
title: Footer data provider: git branch watcher + extension status store
